original_primary_source.author: Paul Bourgade
original_primary_source.locator: Conjecture (0.2), PDF p.2; section 2.2, PDF p.7
original_primary_source.model: Real symmetric independent centered entries (subject to symmetry) on a d-dimensional periodic box; zero beyond periodic L1 distance W; comparable nonzero variances with each row sum equal to one; uniform subgaussian tails assumed in section 2.2.
original_primary_source.d2_prediction: Localized regime W << sqrt(log N), localization length of order exp(W^2), with Poisson local statistics predicted as part of the transition.
original_primary_source.source_quote_1: The localized regime supposedly occurs for W << Wc
original_primary_source.source_quote_2: For d = 2, it is conjectured that all states are localized

recent_primary_source.model: Centered complex Gaussian entries on a two-dimensional discrete torus; entries vanish beyond W.
recent_primary_source.result: All bulk eigenvectors delocalized with high probability if W >= (log N)^7.

note: The fixed-W regime is outside the Lai-Yang v2 condition for all sufficiently large N. The original source states a conjectural transition rather than a theorem with a formal localization definition.
